(NBIS, NASDAQ) is the Netherlands-domiciled successor entity to Yandex N.V., reborn through a 2024 corporate restructuring that separated the Russian operating business from the listed parent and refocused the surviving group on AI infrastructure. Founder and CEO Arkady Volozh — Yandex's CEO between 2000 and 2022 — resumed the chief-executive role in 2024 to lead the transition. FY2026 guidance is the most aggressive in the AI cloud peer set: revenue $3-3.4 billion (roughly 7x FY2025), adjusted EBITDA margin ~40%, capex $16-20 billion, ARR target $7-9 billion with more than half already contracted, and connected power 800 MW-1 GW. The portfolio also includes three smaller branded businesses — Toloka AI (human-data labelling), TripleTen (online tech education), and Avride (autonomous driving) — that operate under separate brands but consolidate into the group. The board is chaired by John Boynton (Yandex co-incubator since 1990, board chairman since 2016) with independent directors Charles Ryan (UFG / Deutsche Bank Russia, Yandex board since 2011 IPO), Kira Radinsky (Diagnostic Robotics CEO, AI-healthcare specialist), Arne Grimme (De Brauw partner, Dutch corporate M&A specialist), and Matthew Weigand (Accel partner, joined August 2025 alongside Nebius's $700M strategic financing from Accel, Nvidia, and Orbis). Elena Bunina (Head of Science and Education) and Ophir Nave (COO, ex-Wachtell and Tel Aviv law professor) hold non-independent executive director seats. The investment proposition compresses a corporate restructuring, a balance-sheet rebuild, a power-and-GPU buildout race against CoreWeave / Lambda / Crusoe / hyperscaler internal capacity, and the strategic question of whether contracted ARR matches the deployed capacity inside the guidance window.

chapters.title: Snapshot
chapters.body:
## A Company Remade

By the frozen snapshot date, Nebius had already moved the debate beyond whether the post-Yandex shell could produce real operating traction. In Q1 2026, Nebius Group reported $399.0 million of revenue, up 684% year on year. The Nebius AI cloud business generated $389.7 million of that figure, annualized run-rate revenue reached $1.92 billion, operating cash flow from continuing operations was $2.258 billion, and the group ended the quarter with $9.3 billion of cash after raising $6.3 billion during the period. Contracted power exceeded 3.5 gigawatts and management raised year-end 2026 contracted-power guidance to more than 4 GW, while reiterating its target of 800 MW to 1 GW of connected power. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

Nebius Group N.V. traded on Nasdaq under the ticker NBIS and filed as a foreign private issuer on Form 20-F, supplemented by 6-K reports. The company was the successor to Yandex N.V. after the sale of the Russia-based businesses was completed on July 15, 2024, and the name and ticker change from Yandex / YNDX to Nebius / NBIS became effective on August 21, 2024. Arkady Volozh, who had served as Yandex chief executive from 2000 until his June 3, 2022 resignation, returned in 2024 to lead the retained international assets. [Sale completion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/ynv-announces-successful-completion-of-the-divestment-of-its-russia-based-businesses), [Official name change](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-official-name-change-and-new-ticker-symbol), [Volozh resignation](https://yandex.com/company/press_center/press_releases/2022/2022-06-03), [Arkady Volozh bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/arkady-volozh)

The operating perimeter was also narrower than the prior draft implied. By Q1 2026, the consolidated group consisted of the core Nebius AI cloud business plus Avride and TripleTen. Toloka had ceased to be consolidated from Q2 2025 after a Bezos Expeditions-led investment left Nebius with a significant economic stake but no majority voting control; Nebius said it would account for Toloka under the equity method instead. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka)

## The FY2025 Print

The FY2025 breakout quarter remained the historical inflection point. In Q4 2025, Nebius reported $227.7 million of revenue, up 547% year on year, while the core AI cloud business grew 802% and generated $214.2 million of Q4 revenue. Exit ARR was $1.25 billion, year-end cash was $3.7 billion, operating cash flow in the quarter was $834 million, and active power reached about 170 MW against more than 2 GW of contracted power. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

| Metric | Q4 2025 | Q1 2026 |
|---|---|---|
| Group revenue | $227.7M | $399.0M |
| Core AI cloud revenue | $214.2M | $389.7M |
| Exit / annualized run-rate revenue | $1.25B | $1.92B |
| Operating cash flow | $834M | $2.258B |
| Cash | $3.7B | $9.3B |
| Capacity marker | ~170MW active; >2GW contracted | >3.5GW contracted; >4GW year-end contracted-power guidance |

The full-year 2025 revenue line is also worth keeping in view because it showed how much of the acceleration was back-end loaded. Nebius generated $529.8 million of revenue for the year, which meant Q4 alone accounted for a very large portion of annual turnover. By Q1 2026 the company had already added another $399.0 million in a single quarter. That sequencing was consistent with management's argument that large contract deliveries, once they began landing, could move the reported revenue base very quickly. [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

[Source: Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Source: Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Source: Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## The Financing Signal

Nebius had also broadened the story from infrastructure finance to software stack expansion. In February 2026, it announced the acquisition of Tavily to add agentic search. In May 2026, it agreed to acquire Eigen AI to strengthen model optimization inside Token Factory and said Clarifai's core team and patent portfolio would be brought in under a license arrangement focused on inference and compute orchestration. That mattered because it meant the company was not asking the market to underwrite only land, power and GPUs; it was also trying to build higher-value software surfaces above the hardware layer. [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory), [Nebius Token Factory launch](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-launches-nebius-token-factory-to-deliver-production-ai-inference-at-scale)

The capital chronology also needed correcting. The $700 million oversubscribed strategic equity financing from Accel, NVIDIA and certain accounts managed by Orbis Investments was announced on December 2, 2024, not in August 2025. The company said at the time that Matt Weigand of Accel would receive board-observer rights and be nominated at the 2025 AGM. Nebius then layered on a public share sale and concurrent convertible-notes financing that produced aggregate gross proceeds of about $4.2 billion in September 2025. In March 2026, NVIDIA deepened the relationship again, agreeing to invest $2 billion as part of a broader engineering partnership. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [September 2025 financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-closings-of-its-public-offering-of-class-a-ordinary-shares-and-concurrent-private-offering-of-convertible-senior-notes-with-aggregate-gross-proceeds-to-date-of-approximately-4-2-billion), [NVIDIA partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nvidia-and-nebius-partner-to-scale-full-stack-ai-cloud), [2025 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-results-of-its-annual-general-meeting)

## The Central Tension

One additional datapoint sharpened that tension. The Q1 2026 release said Nebius had 253,898,194 shares outstanding at March 31, 2026, excluding 68,142,750 Class A shares held in treasury. In other words, a meaningful part of the enlarged cash position had already been paid for with balance-sheet complexity and a broader capital structure. The financing question was not just whether money was available. It was what combination of equity, convertibles, customer prepayments and asset-backed structures would be needed if the company kept running the buildout at first-quarter pace. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

By late May 2026, the question was no longer whether Nebius could raise money or disclose real counterparties. It had already announced a five-year Microsoft contract tied to Vineland, New Jersey, disclosed a Meta agreement that ultimately expanded to a contract value of up to approximately $27 billion, and told shareholders that in Q1 it had met all of its capacity commitments across strategic long-term contracts with Microsoft and Meta. The live question was whether the company could convert that contract book, its enlarged cash balance and NVIDIA's alignment into connected, revenue-producing capacity quickly enough to stay inside the FY2026 window. [Microsoft agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-multi-billion-dollar-agreement-with-microsoft-for-ai-infrastructure), [Microsoft 6-K](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/86625727-9e66-46c1-af79-c27d57434e3c/25-25580-1_Nebius%2520Group%2520N.V._6-K.pdf?cache-buster=2025-09-08T21%3A23%3A09.625Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

chapters.title: From CompTek to Yandex to Nebius
chapters.body:
## From Yandex to Nebius

Nebius did not emerge from a blank shell in 2024. The Yandex search brand launched in 1997 and the corporate entity behind it was established in 2000. Arkady Volozh served as chief executive from 2000 until mid-2022, John Boynton had served on the board since 2000, and Charles Ryan joined as a director at the time of the 2011 Nasdaq listing. That continuity mattered because the post-divestiture company kept more than a listing vehicle: Nebius said in July 2024 that the retained international business included an R&D backbone of more than 1,000 highly skilled AI engineers. [Yandex history](https://yandex.com/company/history/), [Arkady Volozh bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/arkady-volozh), [John Boynton bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/john-boynton), [Charles Ryan bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/charles-ryan), [Investor update](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-planned-resumption-of-trading-on-nasdaq-and-provides-investor-update)

Through the 2010s, Yandex built out many of the assets that later reappeared inside Nebius. By the time the company described the retained portfolio in 2024, it included the Nebius AI cloud business, Toloka, TripleTen and Avride, all of which had roots in the old Yandex technology stack and product portfolio. What the restructuring did was not invent those assets; it separated them from the Russia-based businesses and reassembled them around a new balance sheet and listing identity. [Second-quarter 2024 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-second-quarter-2024-financial-results), [Fourth-quarter 2024 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-financial-results)

## The 2022 Break

The first clean rupture came in June 2022. After being sanctioned by the European Union, Volozh resigned as chief executive and stepped down from the board and executive committee of Yandex N.V. That marked the point at which the company could no longer plausibly be treated by public investors as a conventional cross-border technology listing with Russian operating exposure. The legal and governance disentanglement that followed lasted two years. [Volozh resignation](https://yandex.com/company/press_center/press_releases/2022/2022-06-03)

## The 2024 Separation

The decisive step arrived on February 4, 2024, when Yandex N.V. announced an agreement to sell the Russia-based businesses for consideration valued at approximately $5.4 billion, subject to closing adjustments. The final closing was completed on July 15, 2024. The company said it had received $2.8 billion in cash and 162.5 million Class A shares as consideration and that, after the closing, Nebius Group had severed all connections with the Russia-based businesses. [Divestment completion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/ynv-announces-successful-completion-of-the-divestment-of-its-russia-based-businesses)

The board then formalized the new corporate identity in stages. At the August 15, 2024 annual general meeting, shareholders approved the legal name change from Yandex N.V. to Nebius Group N.V. A few days later, the company said the Nasdaq ticker would change from YNDX to NBIS effective August 21, 2024. In October 2024, it announced the planned resumption of Nasdaq trading and laid out the post-restructuring investment case around AI infrastructure, data, edtech and autonomous driving. [2024 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-formerly-known-as-yandex-n-v-announces-results-of-2024-annual-general-meeting-of-shareholders), [Official name change](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-official-name-change-and-new-ticker-symbol), [Trading resumption update](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-planned-resumption-of-trading-on-nasdaq-and-provides-investor-update)

## Board Reconstruction

The October 2024 investor update underscored that the new company was not presenting itself as a liquidation vehicle. Nebius said the retained group included the Nebius AI cloud business, a majority economic interest in Toloka, TripleTen, Avride and an equity stake in ClickHouse, alongside the retained engineering organization. That disclosure mattered historically because it showed what the board believed it had actually saved from the old Yandex perimeter and why the renamed company still warranted a public-market listing after the sale. [Trading resumption update](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-planned-resumption-of-trading-on-nasdaq-and-provides-investor-update)

The board build after the separation was intentionally transactional and technical. Boynton remained chairman, providing the longest-running governance continuity. Ryan stayed on as an independent director, preserving institutional memory from the listing era. Ophir Nave joined as chief operating officer in May 2024 and was elected as an executive director at the August 2024 AGM; the company described him as a former Wachtell lawyer and an expert in cross-border M&A and corporate law, a profile tailored to the restructuring job. [2024 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-formerly-known-as-yandex-n-v-announces-results-of-2024-annual-general-meeting-of-shareholders), [Ophir Nave bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/ophir-nave)

Elena Bunina also joined the board at the August 2024 AGM. Nebius described her as Head of Science and Education and highlighted her prior roles across Yandex's academic and educational services. Kira Radinsky joined as an independent non-executive director, bringing AI-application and healthcare-technology operating experience. Together those appointments moved the board away from a Russia-internet identity and toward a technology-and-governance mix better suited to an AI infrastructure company. [2024 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-formerly-known-as-yandex-n-v-announces-results-of-2024-annual-general-meeting-of-shareholders), [Elena Bunina bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/elena-bunina), [Kira Radinsky bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/kira-radinsky)

The August 2025 AGM completed the next phase. Arne Grimme, a partner at De Brauw Blackstone Westbroek, added a Dutch legal and M&A anchor. Matthew Weigand, an Accel partner who had first been given observer rights in connection with the December 2024 financing, was elected to the board. The chronology mattered: the governance changes followed the capital infusion, not the other way around. [2025 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-results-of-its-annual-general-meeting), [Arne Grimme bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/arne-grimme), [Matthew Weigand bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/matthew-weigand), [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure)

## Why the History Mattered

There was also a second, less discussed implication of the 2024 separation. Once trading resumed, Nebius was able to describe the retained platform in language that was impossible before the sale: a European AI infrastructure company with global reach, a large retained engineering base, branded assets in cloud, data, edtech and autonomy, and a balance sheet no longer tied to the economics of the Russia-based businesses. The old Yandex lineage still explained the talent base and technical inheritance, but the public-company narrative had changed decisively from emerging-market internet holding company to AI infrastructure operator. [Trading resumption update](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-planned-resumption-of-trading-on-nasdaq-and-provides-investor-update), [Second-quarter 2024 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-second-quarter-2024-financial-results)

The Nebius investment case rested on the proposition that a restructured holding company could move faster than a conventional incumbent. The record through the frozen window showed why investors were willing to entertain that proposition. The company had completed a politically complex divestment, resumed Nasdaq trading under a new name, rebuilt the board, raised outside capital, and repositioned the retained assets around AI infrastructure inside roughly fifteen months. The corporate history was therefore not decorative context. It was the mechanism that made the FY2025 breakout and the FY2026 guidance possible. [Sale completion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/ynv-announces-successful-completion-of-the-divestment-of-its-russia-based-businesses), [Trading resumption update](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-planned-resumption-of-trading-on-nasdaq-and-provides-investor-update), [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results)

chapters.title: Core AI cloud plus three branded subsidiaries
chapters.body:
## The Operating Perimeter Was No Longer Four Equal Pieces

The earlier draft treated Nebius as a simple four-brand rollup. By the frozen snapshot date, the accounting perimeter was more complicated and more informative. The core Nebius AI cloud business was the dominant earnings engine. TripleTen and Avride remained consolidated subsidiaries. Toloka still belonged economically to the group, but after the May 2025 investment transaction led by Bezos Expeditions, Nebius no longer held majority voting power and accounted for Toloka as an equity-method investment rather than a consolidated subsidiary. [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

| Business | Status at snapshot date | What Nebius had publicly disclosed |
|---|---|---|
| Nebius AI cloud | Core consolidated business | $214.2M of Q4 2025 revenue; $389.7M of Q1 2026 revenue; $1.92B ARR in Q1 2026 |
| TripleTen | Consolidated subsidiary | 2025 revenue up 88% YoY; Q1 2026 revenue up 10% YoY |
| Avride | Consolidated subsidiary | Strategic investment from Uber; commercial robotaxi launch in December 2025 |
| Toloka | Equity-method investment | Bezos Expeditions-led round; clients included Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft, poolside, Recraft and Shopify |

[Sources: Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka), [Avride-Uber partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/avride-announces-up-to-375-million-investment-and-strategic-partnership-with-uber)

## Core AI Cloud

The product layering inside the core cloud also became clearer through the period. Nebius highlighted Aether 3.1 in late 2025 and Aether 3.5 in Q1 2026 as releases that improved enterprise readiness, security controls, data transfer and serverless AI. Token Factory extended the offer into production inference and post-training, while the Tavily, Eigen AI and Clarifai transactions pushed further into retrieval, optimization and orchestration. The core segment was therefore growing not just because it had more GPUs, but because management was trying to increase the amount of software and managed-service value wrapped around those GPUs. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Nebius Token Factory launch](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-launches-nebius-token-factory-to-deliver-production-ai-inference-at-scale), [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

The core AI cloud business had become so large by early 2026 that it effectively explained the whole equity story. Nebius disclosed that core AI cloud revenue reached $214.2 million in Q4 2025 out of $227.7 million of group revenue, then climbed to $389.7 million in Q1 2026. ARR moved from $1.25 billion at the end of 2025 to $1.92 billion a quarter later. The business was not just selling raw GPU rental. The company described a full-stack offer spanning owned data-center capacity, managed cloud infrastructure, and higher-level software products such as Nebius Token Factory and Aether. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Nebius Token Factory launch](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-launches-nebius-token-factory-to-deliver-production-ai-inference-at-scale)

The geographic footprint was also more visible than the dossier had suggested. Nebius publicly identified capacity in Finland, Kansas City, New Jersey and Iceland in March 2025, then added a 310 MW AI factory in Finland in March 2026 and a new site in Pennsylvania with up to 1.2 GW of secured power in May 2026. The company also told shareholders it had broken ground at its Missouri location and had secured two gigawatt-scale sites in the United States. [New Jersey expansion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-accelerates-us-expansion-adding-up-to-300-mw-capacity-at-new-data-center-in-new-jersey), [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Toloka

Nebius and Toloka also continued to collaborate after the transaction. In February 2026, the companies said they were integrating Nebius's AI infrastructure with Toloka's human-in-the-loop data services, framing the combination as a way to offer customers a more complete development stack from data preparation to model training and evaluation. The point was not that Toloka remained a reported revenue pillar. It was that Nebius still treated the asset as strategically adjacent even after it left consolidation. [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka), [Nebius and Toloka integration](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-and-toloka-launch-a-joint-offering-combining-ai-infrastructure-and-human-in-the-loop-data-expertise)

Toloka was still strategically relevant even after leaving the consolidation perimeter. In announcing the May 2025 transaction, Nebius said Toloka had more than doubled revenue in 2024 and named customers including Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft, poolside, Recraft and Shopify. The round was led by Bezos Expeditions and was intended to help Toloka accelerate independently while leaving Nebius with a significant economic stake. That made Toloka less a line item in reported revenue and more a separately financed adjacent platform in data generation and model evaluation. [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka)

## TripleTen

TripleTen remained the most conventional operating business in the portfolio. Nebius said in its Q4 2024 materials that TripleTen had enrolled more than 14,000 new students in 2024, up 149% year on year. In the Q4 2025 shareholder letter, management said TripleTen's revenue had grown 88% year on year in 2025, and in the Q1 2026 shareholder letter it said revenue was still growing, up 10% year on year in the first quarter. The company did not disclose a spin-out or sale process, but the public record did show an asset that still had enough growth to justify continued retention rather than immediate disposal. [Fourth-quarter 2024 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-financial-results), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Avride

Avride remained the longest-duration asset in the portfolio, but the public record was fuller than the old draft suggested. In January 2025, the company said Avride and Grubhub were expanding robot delivery at Ohio State University to close to 100 robots. In October 2025, Nebius said Uber and Nebius would invest up to $375 million in Avride and that the companies would develop and deploy autonomous mobility and delivery services together. By the Q4 2025 shareholder letter, Nebius was telling investors that Avride had launched a commercial robotaxi service in December. That did not make Avride the near-term financial driver of the group, but it did move the business from vague moonshot status to disclosed commercial pilot status with a named strategic partner. [Fourth-quarter 2024 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-financial-results), [Avride-Uber partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/avride-announces-up-to-375-million-investment-and-strategic-partnership-with-uber), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

## Revenue Mix

There was also an equity-stakes layer below the consolidated businesses. By Q1 2026, Nebius explicitly described itself as owning equity stakes in ClickHouse and Toloka. Those positions did not drive reported quarterly revenue in the same way the AI cloud, TripleTen and Avride did, but they did mean the portfolio was broader than the consolidated income statement alone suggested. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

The most useful quantitative disclosure was simple arithmetic. When the core AI cloud business produced $214.2 million of the group's $227.7 million Q4 2025 revenue, the remaining consolidated operations together accounted for only a low-teens-million residual. By Q1 2026, when Toloka was no longer consolidated, the gap was even starker: $389.7 million of core AI cloud revenue against $399.0 million of group revenue. That left little doubt about which business the market was being asked to own. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

chapters.title: $3.7B cash and the $20B capex bar
chapters.body:
## FY2025 Was the Breakout; Q1 2026 Was the Validation

When Nebius published its fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results on February 12, 2026, the company turned a restructuring story into an operating story. Q4 revenue came in at $227.7 million and full-year revenue at $529.8 million. The core AI cloud business generated $214.2 million in Q4 revenue, exit ARR reached $1.25 billion, operating cash flow in the quarter was $834 million, and active power reached about 170 MW. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

The more important development for a frozen snapshot dated May 23, 2026 was what happened next. In Q1 2026, Nebius Group reported $399.0 million of revenue, adjusted EBITDA of $129.5 million, net income from continuing operations of $621.2 million, and operating cash flow from continuing operations of $2.258 billion. Purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets were $2.4729 billion in the quarter. The share count at March 31, 2026 was 253,898,194 shares outstanding, excluding 68,142,750 Class A shares held in treasury. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

## The Q1 Arithmetic

The Q1 release also exposed how unusual the cost structure looked at this stage of the ramp. Cost of revenues was $103.8 million, or 26% of revenue, while depreciation and amortization alone was $212.0 million, or 53% of revenue. Product development was $67.4 million and sales, general and administrative expense was $143.8 million. Those line items showed why adjusted EBITDA and GAAP earnings could diverge so sharply in a quarter dominated by prepayments and rapid capacity deployment. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

The shareholder letter added the operating detail the release compressed. Nebius said the AI cloud business generated $389.7 million of revenue in Q1 2026, up 841% year on year and 82% quarter on quarter, while ARR rose to $1.92 billion. The company also said Nebius AI cloud adjusted EBITDA margin had nearly doubled quarter on quarter to 45%. That meant the key question after the Q4 breakout was not whether the trend persisted. It did. The question was whether the capex plan and the contract book could stay synchronized. [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

| Metric | FY2025 exit / Q4 | Q1 2026 |
|---|---|---|
| Group revenue | $227.7M in Q4; $529.8M full year | $399.0M |
| Core AI cloud revenue | $214.2M | $389.7M |
| ARR | $1.25B | $1.92B |
| Operating cash flow | $834M | $2.258B |
| Cash | $3.7B | $9.3B |
| Purchases of PP&E and intangibles | ~$2.0B in Q4 | $2.4729B |

[Sources: Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Revenue and ARR Conversion

Management's FY2026 guide remained the same headline range it had issued in February: $3.0 billion to $3.4 billion of revenue, $7 billion to $9 billion of year-end ARR, and around 40% adjusted EBITDA margin in the core business. What changed between February and May was that the company now had a real first-quarter data point against the range. At $399.0 million of group revenue in Q1 and $389.7 million in core AI cloud revenue, Nebius still needed a steep quarterly ramp to land the year, but the direction of travel was consistent with acceleration rather than early slippage. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## The Capex Problem Did Not Go Away; It Changed Shape

The capital intensity was still extraordinary. The FY2026 capex guide of $16 billion to $20 billion implied a full-year capex-to-revenue ratio of roughly 4.7x to 6.7x against the revenue range midpoint. Q4 2025 had already shown roughly $2 billion of capex against $227.7 million of revenue. Q1 2026 then showed $2.4729 billion of purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets against $399.0 million of revenue. On the evidence available inside the frozen window, Nebius had not moderated the build-ahead model; it had intensified it. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

## Financing Stack

The financing stack was not only larger; it also became more diversified. Management told shareholders that financing options included corporate debt, asset-backed financing and equity. By Q1 2026, the company had already shown a willingness to use both straight equity and convertible structures, while still relying heavily on customer prepayments to support buildout. The important point for the balance-sheet analysis was not that financing risk had vanished. It was that Nebius had moved well beyond a single-round story. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

The dossier's earlier financing chronology was stale. The $700 million oversubscribed strategic equity financing from Accel, NVIDIA and Orbis was announced in December 2024. In September 2025, Nebius closed a public offering of Class A shares and a concurrent private offering of convertible senior notes that together produced approximately $4.2 billion of gross proceeds. In Q1 2026, Nebius raised another $6.3 billion, including a $2 billion equity investment from NVIDIA and $4.3 billion of convertible securities. That is how the company reached $9.3 billion of cash by March 31, 2026. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [September 2025 financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-closings-of-its-public-offering-of-class-a-ordinary-shares-and-concurrent-private-offering-of-convertible-senior-notes-with-aggregate-gross-proceeds-to-date-of-approximately-4-2-billion), [NVIDIA partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nvidia-and-nebius-partner-to-scale-full-stack-ai-cloud), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Margin Mechanics

The progression across quarters made the operating-leverage claim easier to test than the earlier draft allowed. In Q3 2025, group adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to $5.2 million on $146.1 million of revenue. In Q4 2025, the shareholder letter said the group was positive on adjusted EBITDA for the first time. In Q1 2026, the group reported $129.5 million of adjusted EBITDA. The mix between prepayments, utilization and non-cash charges still mattered, but the quarter sequence did show a business moving rapidly toward scale economics rather than drifting sideways. [Nebius Q3 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/fc878470-ce91-4c8a-a716-45fe2923d603/20251111%20Nebius%20reports%20third%20quarter%202025%20financial%20results.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A56%3A42.300Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

The margin story was one of the cleaner positive surprises in the public record. The core AI cloud adjusted EBITDA margin had risen from 19% in Q3 2025 to 24% in Q4 2025. Management then said the AI cloud margin had nearly doubled quarter on quarter to 45% in Q1 2026. Even allowing for the distortions created by prepayments, contract timing and rapid fixed-cost absorption, the direction of travel was clear: the operating model could scale. [Nebius Q3 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/fc878470-ce91-4c8a-a716-45fe2923d603/20251111%20Nebius%20reports%20third%20quarter%202025%20financial%20results.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A56%3A42.300Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Power, Contracts and the Real Constraint

The external numbers worth trusting most were still the physical ones. Nebius ended 2025 with about 170 MW of active power. By Q1 2026, it said contracted power had already exceeded 3.5 GW, that more than 75% of contracted power was owned capacity, and that it had secured two gigawatt-scale sites in the United States. That was the bridge between the financing stack and the revenue guide. If the power came online on time, the contracts could convert. If it did not, the income statement would lag the capital spent on it. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results)

chapters.title: From restructuring print to first-billion ARR
chapters.body:
## From Small Base to Visible Scale

The earnings story was not a straight line, but the trajectory through the frozen window was unmistakable. On a continuing-operations basis as later restated after Toloka's deconsolidation, Nebius reported $50.9 million of revenue in Q1 2025, $105.1 million in Q2 2025, $146.1 million in Q3 2025, $227.7 million in Q4 2025 and $399.0 million in Q1 2026. That was the core reason investors stopped treating the company as a post-restructuring curiosity and started treating it as a real AI infrastructure ramp. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q2 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/a1ea2731-32b4-4b8d-82b4-0557fddadd1a/Nebius%20-%20Financial%20results%20-%20Q2%202025.pdf?cache-buster=2025-08-26T16%3A52%3A29.128Z), [Nebius Q3 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/fc878470-ce91-4c8a-a716-45fe2923d603/20251111%20Nebius%20reports%20third%20quarter%202025%20financial%20results.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A56%3A42.300Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z)

## December 2024 Reset the Capital Base

The first decisive earnings-story catalyst was not an income-statement line. It was the December 2024 $700 million strategic equity financing from Accel, NVIDIA and Orbis. That financing let Nebius accelerate the buildout before the revenue had caught up, and it brought Matt Weigand into the governance picture as a board observer ahead of his election in 2025. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [2025 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-results-of-its-annual-general-meeting)

## Q2 and Q3 2025 Turned Narrative Into Operating Evidence

The quarter-to-quarter shape also mattered. Q2 2025 more than doubled revenue from the restated Q1 base and was the moment management raised ARR guidance for the year. Q3 2025 then took revenue to $146.1 million and produced a step-change in visibility: ARR at the end of September was about $551 million, the company was on track for 220 MW of connected power and 100 MW of active power by year-end, and two named hyperscale relationships were now in public view. In other words, the earnings story stopped being a one-metric growth narrative and became a three-way confirmation story across revenue, power and counterparties. [Nebius Q2 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/a1ea2731-32b4-4b8d-82b4-0557fddadd1a/Nebius%20-%20Financial%20results%20-%20Q2%202025.pdf?cache-buster=2025-08-26T16%3A52%3A29.128Z), [Nebius Q3 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/fc878470-ce91-4c8a-a716-45fe2923d603/20251111%20Nebius%20reports%20third%20quarter%202025%20financial%20results.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A56%3A42.300Z), [Nebius Q3 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/94ab89ea-f954-4516-89f0-1c137e0edd56/Nebius%20Group%20Q3%20Shareholder%20Letter.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A46%3A23.648Z)

By the second quarter of 2025, management was already raising ARR guidance and explaining that Toloka would no longer be consolidated after its external financing. In Q3 2025, revenue reached $146.1 million, and Nebius announced a new Meta agreement valued at approximately $3 billion over five years. The Q3 shareholder letter also said annualized run-rate revenue at the end of September was approximately $551 million and that the company was on track for 220 MW of connected power and 100 MW of active power by year-end 2025. [Nebius Q2 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/a1ea2731-32b4-4b8d-82b4-0557fddadd1a/Nebius%20-%20Financial%20results%20-%20Q2%202025.pdf?cache-buster=2025-08-26T16%3A52%3A29.128Z), [Nebius Q3 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/fc878470-ce91-4c8a-a716-45fe2923d603/20251111%20Nebius%20reports%20third%20quarter%202025%20financial%20results.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A56%3A42.300Z), [Nebius Q3 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/94ab89ea-f954-4516-89f0-1c137e0edd56/Nebius%20Group%20Q3%20Shareholder%20Letter.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A46%3A23.648Z)

## Q4 2025 Reframed the Year

There was also a cash-flow story inside the earnings progression. Q4 2025's $834 million of operating cash flow and Q1 2026's $2.258 billion showed that the company was not merely recognizing revenue faster; it was pulling customer cash forward through reservation and prepayment structures. That mattered for interpretation of every quarter in the series. Nebius was not waiting for utilization to fully mature before funding the next round of capacity. It was using contract cash to help finance the buildout before the revenue caught up. [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

The Q4 print was the point at which the earlier quarters read like prelude. Group revenue rose to $227.7 million, core AI cloud revenue to $214.2 million, exit ARR to $1.25 billion, and active power to roughly 170 MW. The company also disclosed that it had delivered the first tranche of capacity to Microsoft on time in November 2025 and both contracted tranches to Meta on time. Those details mattered because they linked reported revenue to actual contractual execution rather than just market enthusiasm. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

## Guidance Was Aggressive, but It Was Not Unsupported

The FY2026 guide that accompanied the February 2026 results was aggressive by any public-market standard: $3.0 billion to $3.4 billion of revenue, $7 billion to $9 billion of ARR, 800 MW to 1 GW of connected power and $16 billion to $20 billion of capex. But management paired that range with two disclosures that made it more than a pipeline deck: more than half of the ARR target was already contracted, and contracted power was already above 2 GW at year-end 2025. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

## Q1 2026 Showed the Story Was Still Accelerating

The most important fact inside the frozen window was that the next quarter did not show a stumble. Q1 2026 group revenue was $399.0 million, Nebius AI cloud revenue was $389.7 million, ARR rose to $1.92 billion, operating cash flow reached $2.258 billion and the AI cloud adjusted EBITDA margin rose to 45%. The quarter therefore did not settle the FY2026 debate, but it did establish that the company entered the year ahead of where a skeptic would have expected after such an aggressive February guide. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

chapters.title: Yandex legacy plus the Accel-and-Nvidia-aligned new arrivals
chapters.body:
## The Founder Returned With a Different Corporate Vehicle

Arkady Volozh re-entered the chief executive role in 2024 with two things few turnaround managers ever inherit at once: deep product memory and a freshly recapitalized public vehicle. The product memory came from having served as Yandex chief executive from 2000 to 2022. The capital base came first from the December 2024 $700 million financing and later from much larger 2025 and 2026 raises. Nebius therefore did not ask investors to trust an outside operator dropped into a distressed shell. It asked them to back the founder who had returned to the part of the old company he believed could compound. [Arkady Volozh bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/arkady-volozh), [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Institutional Memory

John Boynton remained the board's continuity anchor. Nebius described him as a director since 2000 and chairman since 2016, which meant he spanned the Yandex listing era, the sanctions rupture and the Nebius relaunch. Charles Ryan provided the second long-duration thread. His bio tied him to the 2011 IPO era and to the financial architecture of the older Yandex shareholder base. In a company asking investors to distinguish between a Russia-based operating history and a newly separated international platform, that continuity had practical value. [John Boynton bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/john-boynton), [Charles Ryan bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/charles-ryan)

## Legal and Transactional Architecture

Ophir Nave's role was easier to understand once the restructuring was viewed as the company's formative event rather than a historical footnote. Nebius said he joined as chief operating officer in May 2024 and was elected as an executive director at the August 2024 AGM. His public biography highlighted Harvard legal training, Wachtell experience and a focus on corporate and M&A work. Those were not decorative credentials for an AI company. They were the credentials of an operator hired to finish a complex cross-border separation and then help finance a capital-intensive buildout. [2024 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-formerly-known-as-yandex-n-v-announces-results-of-2024-annual-general-meeting-of-shareholders), [Ophir Nave bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/ophir-nave)

## Science, Education and AI-Domain Expertise

The individual bios also explained why the board looked unusually specialized for a newly rebuilt public company. Bunina's profile linked mathematics, research publishing and education operations. Radinsky had founded and sold an AI company before moving into healthcare AI. Nave's biography emphasized both top-tier legal training and cross-border transaction work. Grimme anchored the Dutch-law side, while Weigand represented a venture investor whose firm had already underwritten the story with cash. Nebius was therefore asking the market to read the board less as a compliance requirement and more as a blueprint for the work ahead: fundraise, govern, recruit, ship and, if necessary, transact again. [Elena Bunina bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/elena-bunina), [Kira Radinsky bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/kira-radinsky), [Ophir Nave bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/ophir-nave), [Arne Grimme bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/arne-grimme), [Matthew Weigand bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/matthew-weigand)

Elena Bunina gave the board a direct bridge into the science-and-education side of the old Yandex network. Nebius said she joined the board in August 2024 and served as Head of Science and Education. Kira Radinsky added current AI-application operating experience as chief executive of Diagnostic Robotics and founder of Mana Bio. If Volozh represented engineering memory and Nave represented legal architecture, Bunina and Radinsky represented the talent and application layer that a modern AI infrastructure platform needed around it. [2024 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-formerly-known-as-yandex-n-v-announces-results-of-2024-annual-general-meeting-of-shareholders), [Elena Bunina bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/elena-bunina), [Kira Radinsky bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/kira-radinsky)

## The Financing Directors

The formal governance mix by the frozen window was also clearer than the old draft had made it sound. Nebius's public board materials showed executive directors in Volozh and Nave, a chairman in Boynton, long-tenured independent continuity in Ryan, functional expertise in Bunina and Radinsky, and transaction-focused additions in Grimme and Weigand. It was a board assembled around a company that expected to raise capital repeatedly, manage regulated public-company obligations in the Netherlands and the United States, and still make product decisions fast enough to stay relevant in AI infrastructure. [John Boynton bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/john-boynton), [Charles Ryan bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/charles-ryan), [Ophir Nave bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/ophir-nave), [Elena Bunina bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/elena-bunina), [Kira Radinsky bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/kira-radinsky), [Arne Grimme bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/arne-grimme), [Matthew Weigand bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/matthew-weigand)

The August 2025 AGM added two directors whose relevance was inseparable from the financing story. Arne Grimme brought Dutch public-company and M&A expertise as a De Brauw partner. Matthew Weigand brought Accel onto the board after first receiving observer rights in connection with the December 2024 financing. That chronology was the key correction: the governance change followed the strategic equity round announced in December 2024, not an August 2025 placement. [2025 AGM results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-results-of-its-annual-general-meeting), [Arne Grimme bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/arne-grimme), [Matthew Weigand bio](https://nebius.com/board-of-directors/matthew-weigand), [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure)

## Leadership as Capital Formation

Nebius's board mattered not just for governance but for fundraising credibility. The company raised about $4.2 billion in September 2025 and another $6.3 billion in Q1 2026. Investors buying into those financings were not underwriting a generic AI theme. They were underwriting a specific leadership bundle: founder credibility, Dutch legal competence, experienced independent directors, and a venture representative whose firm had already written a check. That was why the board composition read less like normal corporate housekeeping and more like the staffing chart of a company in permanent transaction mode. [September 2025 financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-closings-of-its-public-offering-of-class-a-ordinary-shares-and-concurrent-private-offering-of-convertible-senior-notes-with-aggregate-gross-proceeds-to-date-of-approximately-4-2-billion), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

chapters.title: Hyperscaler-adjacent customers, Nvidia-aligned supply
chapters.body:
## Nebius Had Disclosed More Customers Than the Earlier Draft Allowed

Nebius still did not publish a full customer list, but by the frozen snapshot date it had named enough counterparties to make the old "customer names not disclosed" framing too blunt. In August 2024, the company said Nebius AI was already serving customers including Mistral AI, Luma AI and JetBrains. In later shareholder materials, it named Genesis Molecular AI, World Labs, Higgsfield AI, Photoroom and Sword Health as examples of AI-native and enterprise customers using the platform. [Second-quarter 2024 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-second-quarter-2024-financial-results), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

The really important names, however, were Microsoft and Meta. They told investors that Nebius was not just selling opportunistic spot capacity to small labs; it had become a disclosed counterparty to hyperscale buyers signing multi-year capacity agreements. [Microsoft agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-multi-billion-dollar-agreement-with-microsoft-for-ai-infrastructure), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta)

## Microsoft

On September 8, 2025, Nebius announced a five-year agreement to deliver dedicated cloud compute capacity to Microsoft from its Vineland, New Jersey data center, with first delivery planned for November 2025. In the accompanying 6-K, Nebius said the contract had a current total contract value of approximately $17.4 billion through 2031, increasing to approximately $19.4 billion if Microsoft took certain additional software and services. By the Q4 2025 shareholder letter, Nebius said it had delivered the first tranche on time in November and remained on track to deliver the rest on schedule. [Microsoft agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-multi-billion-dollar-agreement-with-microsoft-for-ai-infrastructure), [Microsoft 6-K](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/86625727-9e66-46c1-af79-c27d57434e3c/25-25580-1_Nebius%2520Group%2520N.V._6-K.pdf?cache-buster=2025-09-08T21%3A23%3A09.625Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

## Meta

Meta first appeared publicly in November 2025, when Nebius said it had signed a new AI infrastructure deal valued at approximately $3 billion over five years. The relationship expanded dramatically on March 18, 2026, when Nebius said it had signed another agreement with Meta carrying a total contract value of up to approximately $27 billion over five years. Nebius described the new agreement as including dedicated capacity worth approximately $12 billion beginning in early 2027, plus up to approximately $15 billion of additional available-capacity commitments if Nebius had not already sold that compute to third parties. [Nebius Q3 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/fc878470-ce91-4c8a-a716-45fe2923d603/20251111%20Nebius%20reports%20third%20quarter%202025%20financial%20results.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A56%3A42.300Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta)

The execution commentary was equally important. In the Q4 2025 shareholder letter, Nebius said both contracted Meta tranches had been delivered on time and had moved into the servicing stage. In the Q1 2026 shareholder letter, management said the company had met all of its capacity commitments across strategic long-term contracts with Microsoft and Meta. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## The NVIDIA Equation

The commercial terms Nebius described around those strategic customers also hinted at why supply discipline mattered so much. Microsoft was tied to dedicated capacity from a named site. Meta's expanded agreement explicitly distinguished between dedicated capacity and additional available capacity that Nebius could otherwise sell elsewhere. These were not generic cloud-consumption arrangements. They were power-and-capacity reservation agreements in which the economics of each megawatt and each delivery date mattered directly to margin and future fundraising credibility. [Microsoft 6-K](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/86625727-9e66-46c1-af79-c27d57434e3c/25-25580-1_Nebius%2520Group%2520N.V._6-K.pdf?cache-buster=2025-09-08T21%3A23%3A09.625Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta)

No supply relationship mattered more than NVIDIA. The December 2024 strategic equity financing made NVIDIA a shareholder. The March 2026 partnership deepened the relationship again, pairing a $2 billion NVIDIA investment with broader collaboration on AI-factory design, software and the inference stack. Nebius told shareholders that it had achieved NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status on GB300 NVL72 for training and was among the first cloud providers to hold that status across multiple GPU generations. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [NVIDIA partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nvidia-and-nebius-partner-to-scale-full-stack-ai-cloud), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Sites and Physical Supply

The go-to-market detail in the shareholder letters also helped fill out the customer picture. In Q4 2025, Nebius said it was gaining traction in healthcare and life sciences, physical AI, and media and entertainment, and specifically named Genesis Molecular AI, World Labs, Higgsfield AI and Photoroom. In Q1 2026, it added Sword Health as an example of a customer using the platform. Those references did not amount to a full customer ledger, but they did show that Nebius's demand base stretched beyond two hyperscaler-style anchor contracts. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

The dossier's earlier hardware-vendor list was not supported by primary disclosure, but the site map was richer than it had suggested. In March 2025, Nebius announced a new New Jersey data center with up to 300 MW of capacity and said it already operated in Kansas City and Iceland. In March 2026, it announced a 310 MW AI factory in Finland. In May 2026, it announced a Pennsylvania site with up to 1.2 GW of power and said it had broken ground in Missouri. This was the real supply chain Nebius was disclosing: not every box supplier, but the land, power and owned-capacity footprint needed to fulfill Microsoft and Meta-sized contracts. [New Jersey expansion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-accelerates-us-expansion-adding-up-to-300-mw-capacity-at-new-data-center-in-new-jersey), [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Investors and Counterparties Were Part of the Same Story

Accel, Orbis and NVIDIA were not merely financing counterparties; they were part of a broader credibility stack that helped Nebius win customers willing to sign very large, long-duration reservations. But by May 2026 the story had moved beyond the December 2024 round. The more meaningful external validation was the combination of disclosed Microsoft and Meta contracts, the March 2026 NVIDIA investment, and the physical buildout that management said sat behind them. The company still had to execute. It no longer had to ask investors to believe in a customer book that was wholly anonymous. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [Microsoft agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-multi-billion-dollar-agreement-with-microsoft-for-ai-infrastructure), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta), [NVIDIA partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nvidia-and-nebius-partner-to-scale-full-stack-ai-cloud)

chapters.title: Where Nebius sits in the AI cloud landscape
chapters.body:
The AI infrastructure market that Nebius entered under its new identity in 2024 was already stratified, but Nebius's own disclosures made its intended lane reasonably clear. The company was not trying to become a hyperscaler in the Amazon, Microsoft or Google sense. It was trying to become a scaled independent AI cloud with enough contracted demand, power and financing to serve customers who either needed capacity those hyperscalers could not readily provide or preferred an AI-specialized provider. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Where Nebius Sat

The simplest way to think about the market was in three layers. At the top sat the hyperscalers, which sold AI compute inside much broader cloud relationships. Beneath them sat the independent GPU-cloud providers, where capacity delivery, financing access and NVIDIA alignment mattered more than enterprise-software bundling. Below that sat regional and specialty operators competing on location, compliance or narrower technical niches. Nebius plainly aimed at the middle layer. Its public disclosures consistently emphasized full-stack AI cloud infrastructure, owned data-center capacity and multi-year customer contracts rather than broad enterprise SaaS or consumer internet adjacency. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## What Nebius Had That Was Unusual

By May 2026, Nebius had disclosed four competitive assets that were unusual even within the independent-cloud cohort.

First, it had named contract counterparties at a scale that most younger AI clouds had not publicly matched: a Microsoft agreement with disclosed value of roughly $17.4 billion through 2031, rising to about $19.4 billion with additional services, and a Meta agreement with total contract value of up to roughly $27 billion over five years. [Microsoft 6-K](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/86625727-9e66-46c1-af79-c27d57434e3c/25-25580-1_Nebius%2520Group%2520N.V._6-K.pdf?cache-buster=2025-09-08T21%3A23%3A09.625Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta)

Second, it had financing depth. Year-end 2025 cash had been $3.7 billion; by March 31, 2026, cash had risen to $9.3 billion after $6.3 billion of Q1 fundraising and $2.258 billion of operating cash inflow. That did not make the $16 billion to $20 billion capex program easy, but it did put Nebius in a stronger starting position than most independent peers could claim from their own balance sheets. [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

Third, it had NVIDIA alignment in two separate forms: the December 2024 strategic equity round and the March 2026 $2 billion NVIDIA investment paired with deeper technical collaboration. In a market where next-generation GPU supply was a gating factor, that mattered. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [NVIDIA partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nvidia-and-nebius-partner-to-scale-full-stack-ai-cloud)

Fourth, it had a disclosed power pipeline that had moved beyond a single-country footprint. Nebius ended 2025 at about 170 MW of active power, entered Q1 2026 with contracted power above 3.5 GW, and said it had secured gigawatt-scale U.S. sites while adding a 310 MW Finnish AI factory. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## What Nebius Did Not Yet Have

The contract evidence also cut both ways competitively. Very large reservations from Microsoft and Meta gave Nebius a public answer to the question of whether serious buyers trusted it. They also raised the performance bar relative to smaller independent peers, because the company now had to deliver against contracts whose size made ordinary slippage harder to hide. Competitive position and execution risk were therefore inseparable. Nebius's strongest competitive proof point also became the thing that would most quickly expose operational weakness if the ramp slipped. [Microsoft 6-K](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/86625727-9e66-46c1-af79-c27d57434e3c/25-25580-1_Nebius%2520Group%2520N.V._6-K.pdf?cache-buster=2025-09-08T21%3A23%3A09.625Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

The public record also showed what Nebius still lacked. It did not have a long public operating history as an AI cloud under the Nebius name. It did not have a demonstrated year of multi-billion-dollar delivered revenue; at the snapshot date it had one breakout quarter and one validating quarter. And even after the March 2026 raise, it still faced a capex plan that exceeded the cash on hand. Those were not minor caveats. They were the core execution conditions attached to the thesis. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Geography and Jurisdiction

The company's own materials also suggested a subtle competitive advantage in customer conversation, not just in power procurement. Nebius repeatedly marketed itself as a full-stack AI cloud that could support both AI-native startups and larger enterprises with stricter compliance demands. References to HIPAA, enterprise governance controls and sector-specific traction in healthcare, physical AI and media implied an effort to compete not only for frontier-model training, but for a broader slice of production AI workloads than a pure spot-capacity seller typically would. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

Geography also worked in Nebius's favor. The company was headquartered in Amsterdam, had legacy capacity in Finland and other EMEA locations, and was rapidly expanding in the United States. For customers looking for non-China, non-Russia infrastructure with both European and U.S. delivery options, Nebius's footprint gave it a cleaner jurisdictional story than the old Yandex identity would have implied. [Official name change](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-official-name-change-and-new-ticker-symbol), [New Jersey expansion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-accelerates-us-expansion-adding-up-to-300-mw-capacity-at-new-data-center-in-new-jersey), [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results)

## Competitive Positioning Was Therefore an Option on Execution

The right frame for Nebius's competitive position was not that it had already joined the hyperscalers. It was that it had assembled enough capital, customer evidence and power pipeline to make a tier jump plausible if management executed. The company had done enough by May 2026 to earn that possibility. It had not done enough to make the jump a fact. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

chapters.title: From restructuring close to $700M financing
chapters.body:
## The Corporate Reset in 2024

The first catalyst was structural rather than operational. Yandex N.V. completed the sale of the Russia-based businesses on July 15, 2024, then moved through the formal steps required to become Nebius Group N.V. and change the Nasdaq ticker from YNDX to NBIS effective August 21, 2024. Trading resumed in October 2024 with a sharply narrowed asset base and a newly explicit AI infrastructure strategy. [Sale completion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/ynv-announces-successful-completion-of-the-divestment-of-its-russia-based-businesses), [Official name change](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-official-name-change-and-new-ticker-symbol), [Trading resumption update](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-planned-resumption-of-trading-on-nasdaq-and-provides-investor-update)

## December 2024 Financing

The second catalyst was capital. On December 2, 2024, Nebius announced a $700 million oversubscribed strategic equity financing from Accel, NVIDIA and Orbis. That round did two things at once: it recapitalized the company for the infrastructure buildout and attached outside names with enough signaling value to change how the market read the post-restructuring entity. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure)

## 2025 Turned Capacity Into Named Counterparties

There was a second layer to the 2025 catalyst map as well: internal product readiness. By the end of 2025 Nebius was talking not only about sites and contracts, but about Aether releases, Token Factory, enterprise security features and additional go-to-market verticals. That progression helped explain why management believed the customer set could widen beyond a few giant reserved-capacity contracts as 2026 progressed. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Token Factory launch](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-launches-nebius-token-factory-to-deliver-production-ai-inference-at-scale)

The 2025 news flow then became progressively more concrete. In March, Nebius announced a New Jersey site with up to 300 MW of capacity and said it already operated in Kansas City and Iceland.
