In September, it disclosed a large Microsoft agreement tied to Vineland, New Jersey and then closed roughly $4.2 billion of additional financing. In November, it reported third-quarter results and disclosed a Meta agreement valued at approximately $3 billion over five years. [New Jersey expansion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-accelerates-us-expansion-adding-up-to-300-mw-capacity-at-new-data-center-in-new-jersey), [Microsoft agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-multi-billion-dollar-agreement-with-microsoft-for-ai-infrastructure), [September 2025 financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-closings-of-its-public-offering-of-class-a-ordinary-shares-and-concurrent-private-offering-of-convertible-senior-notes-with-aggregate-gross-proceeds-to-date-of-approximately-4-2-billion), [Nebius Q3 2025 release](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/fc878470-ce91-4c8a-a716-45fe2923d603/20251111%20Nebius%20reports%20third%20quarter%202025%20financial%20results.pdf?cache-buster=2025-11-11T11%3A56%3A42.300Z)

## February 2026 Made the Operating Ramp Legible

On February 12, 2026, Nebius reported Q4 and full-year 2025 results. That was the first print that made the company's scale aspirations look numerically coherent: $227.7 million of Q4 revenue, $529.8 million for the year, $1.25 billion of exit ARR, $834 million of Q4 operating cash flow, and 170 MW of active power against more than 2 GW contracted. The company also raised year-end 2026 contracted-power guidance to more than 3 GW. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

## March to May 2026 Shifted the Story Again

Those same months also produced product-side catalysts. Tavily was announced in February, Eigen AI in May and Clarifai's core team and IP license in May. The message was that Nebius intended to use the financing window not only to buy land and power, but also to accelerate its inference, agentic and orchestration capabilities. For investors trying to decide whether Nebius would remain a capital-heavy infrastructure landlord or become a fuller software-and-services platform, those transactions were part of the answer. [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

The frozen window included another major turn. In March 2026, Nebius announced a new 310 MW AI factory in Finland, expanded its Meta relationship to a contract value of up to approximately $27 billion, and announced a $2 billion NVIDIA investment paired with broader technical collaboration. On May 13, 2026, it reported Q1 2026 results showing $399.0 million of revenue, $2.258 billion of operating cash flow and $9.3 billion of cash, while announcing a Pennsylvania site with up to 1.2 GW of secured power. [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta), [NVIDIA partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nvidia-and-nebius-partner-to-scale-full-stack-ai-cloud), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## What Still Counted as a Forward Catalyst

The site timeline itself had become a catalyst stream. New Jersey showed the company could secure U.S. capacity. Finland showed it could commit to large owned EMEA infrastructure. Pennsylvania and Missouri showed the company was moving toward gigawatt-scale U.S. footprints. Each site announcement mattered not as a standalone headline, but as incremental proof that Nebius's contracted-power claims were tied to identified projects rather than to a purely conceptual pipeline. [New Jersey expansion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-accelerates-us-expansion-adding-up-to-300-mw-capacity-at-new-data-center-in-new-jersey), [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

That sequence changed what still counted as an unresolved catalyst by May 23, 2026. The Q1 2026 filing was no longer hypothetical; it was already in the market. The live catalysts were therefore narrower and more operational: evidence that the Pennsylvania, Missouri and Finland projects were moving from contracted to connected power; more proof that Microsoft and Meta commitments were being delivered on schedule; and any further financing or acquisitions that deepened the software stack without loosening discipline on the capex build. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

chapters.title: From Yandex Cloud to full-stack AI infrastructure
chapters.body:
## The Inherited Stack

When Nebius emerged from the 2024 restructuring, it retained more than cash. The company repeatedly described itself as being built on deep in-house technology, production-grade cloud engineering and a large retained R&D organization. In the October 2024 investor update, Nebius said the company had an R&D backbone of more than 1,000 highly skilled AI engineers. That was the starting point for the Nebius AI cloud platform rather than a greenfield build. [Trading resumption update](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-planned-resumption-of-trading-on-nasdaq-and-provides-investor-update), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Engineering Geography

The engineering footprint remained deliberately distributed. The holding-company and governance layer sat in the Netherlands. Finland remained the key physical infrastructure anchor. Israel showed up repeatedly in leadership and engineering descriptions. By 2025 and 2026, the company was also building a meaningful U.S. engineering and operating presence through New Jersey, Missouri and Pennsylvania. [Official name change](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-n-v-announces-official-name-change-and-new-ticker-symbol), [New Jersey expansion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-accelerates-us-expansion-adding-up-to-300-mw-capacity-at-new-data-center-in-new-jersey), [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results)

## Toloka and the Data Layer

Toloka's strategic value was clearer after the May 2025 financing than before it. Nebius said Toloka had more than doubled revenue in 2024 and named customers including Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft, poolside, Recraft and Shopify. Even after deconsolidation, Toloka remained part of the broader Nebius technology perimeter: a data-generation and evaluation platform adjacent to training and inference infrastructure. [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka)

## Token Factory and the Move Up the Stack

The infrastructure layer itself was evolving quickly. In the Q4 2025 shareholder letter, Nebius said it had been the first provider in Europe to deploy NVIDIA HGX B300 Blackwell Ultra systems in production with NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand, and that it had achieved Gold status in the SemiAnalysis ClusterMAX 2.0 ranking. In Q1 2026, the company said it had achieved NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status on GB300 NVL72 for training and was among the first providers to hold that status across multiple GPU generations. Those statements did not prove a permanent moat, but they did show a company trying to differentiate on system design and deployment quality rather than on simple access to commodity capacity. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

The product record within the frozen window showed Nebius pushing above raw infrastructure. In November 2025, it launched Nebius Token Factory as a production AI inference platform. In February 2026 it agreed to acquire Tavily to add agentic search. In May 2026 it agreed to acquire Eigen AI to strengthen post-training optimization and welcomed Clarifai's core team while licensing Clarifai's inference IP and patent portfolio. That sequence mattered because it answered the moat question more concretely than the prior draft had: Nebius was trying to own not just GPU capacity but the software and optimization layers that determined how efficiently that capacity got used. [Nebius Token Factory launch](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-launches-nebius-token-factory-to-deliver-production-ai-inference-at-scale), [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

## Avride and Applied AI

Nebius's own product roadmap language around Aether 3.5 also filled in part of the engineering picture the old draft had left vague. The company said the release added serverless AI, a data-transfer service for moving data across clouds at petabyte scale, and stronger governance, billing and audit-log capabilities. Those are not patent-count disclosures, but they are concrete examples of engineering work that moved the platform toward production inference and enterprise deployment rather than remaining a training-only GPU cloud. [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

Avride was still the most speculative operating asset, but Nebius's own disclosures made the rationale for keeping it easier to understand. The company linked Avride to physical AI, autonomous delivery and robotaxi systems, and said Uber and Nebius would invest up to $375 million in October 2025. That gave Nebius a live applied-AI workload adjacent to the infrastructure it was building, even if Avride was not the main earnings driver. [Avride-Uber partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/avride-announces-up-to-375-million-investment-and-strategic-partnership-with-uber), [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf)

## On Intellectual Property

The earlier draft said public filings had not surfaced a specific count of patents. That remained true as to a consolidated patent tally, but the frozen-window record did disclose something more concrete: on May 12, 2026 Nebius said it had licensed Clarifai's inference IP and patent portfolio as part of bringing over Clarifai's core team. In other words, the public record did not give a neat patent count, but it did show Nebius actively adding identifiable IP around inference optimization and compute orchestration. [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

chapters.title: Capex bar, customer concentration, and the restructuring overhang
chapters.body:
## Financing Risk Was Still Real, but the Baseline Had Shifted

The earlier draft framed Nebius's core financing risk around a $3.7 billion cash balance and a $16 billion to $20 billion capex guide. That was accurate for February 2026 and stale by May 23. By the end of Q1 2026, Nebius had $9.3 billion of cash after $6.3 billion of fundraising in the quarter and $2.258 billion of operating cash inflow from continuing operations. The capex guide had not changed. The financing risk therefore did not disappear; it changed from an immediate liquidity question into a question of whether the balance sheet, prepayments and future financing could keep pace with the power buildout. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Customer Concentration Was More Visible Than Before

The old draft treated customer concentration largely as an inference from undisclosed names. By the frozen snapshot date, Microsoft and Meta were disclosed. That was progress in transparency, but it also made the concentration issue more concrete. Microsoft's contract was described as having current value of about $17.4 billion through 2031, rising to about $19.4 billion if additional services were taken. Meta's March 2026 agreement had total value of up to about $27 billion over five years. Those are the numbers of a company whose near-term revenue trajectory could still be meaningfully shaped by a small number of very large counterparties. [Microsoft 6-K](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/86625727-9e66-46c1-af79-c27d57434e3c/25-25580-1_Nebius%2520Group%2520N.V._6-K.pdf?cache-buster=2025-09-08T21%3A23%3A09.625Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta)

**Leading indicator:** whether Nebius keeps disclosing additional large customers and whether the mix of AI-native and enterprise logos broadens beyond a handful of strategic anchor names. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## NVIDIA Alignment Reduced Risk, It Did Not Remove It

NVIDIA's role had also evolved beyond the single December 2024 equity round. By March 2026, NVIDIA had invested another $2 billion and expanded the engineering partnership around AI-factory design, hardware, software and inference. That strengthened the supply thesis, but it still did not amount to a public contractual guarantee that every future GPU generation would arrive exactly when Nebius needed it. The supply risk therefore became one of execution timing rather than of complete supplier indifference. [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [NVIDIA partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nvidia-and-nebius-partner-to-scale-full-stack-ai-cloud)

**Leading indicator:** slippage between contracted power growth, connected-power milestones and disclosed customer deliveries. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Power Was Still the Binding Constraint

The physical bottleneck remained the cleanest one to state. Nebius ended 2025 with about 170 MW of active power. By Q1 2026, the company said contracted power had already exceeded 3.5 GW and raised year-end 2026 contracted-power guidance to more than 4 GW, while keeping its connected-power target at 800 MW to 1 GW. The financing had arrived faster than the power could plausibly be activated. That was not a criticism of management; it was the nature of utility, permitting and construction timelines. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

**Leading indicator:** quarterly updates on connected and active power at the Pennsylvania, Missouri, New Jersey and Finland sites. [New Jersey expansion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-accelerates-us-expansion-adding-up-to-300-mw-capacity-at-new-data-center-in-new-jersey), [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results)

## Restructuring Overhang

The Russia-lineage overhang did not vanish simply because the sale had been completed. Some investors would continue to treat Nebius with caution because of its origin. But the frozen-window record also showed that the overhang had not prevented large outside capital formation: the company raised $700 million in December 2024, about $4.2 billion in September 2025 and $6.3 billion in Q1 2026. The risk therefore shifted from "can Nebius raise?" to "does the legacy narrow the eventual buyer base relative to what a similarly performing clean-sheet AI company might command?" [Sale completion](https://nebius.com/newsroom/ynv-announces-successful-completion-of-the-divestment-of-its-russia-based-businesses), [Strategic equity financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-oversubscribed-strategic-equity-financing-of-usd-700-million-to-accelerate-roll-out-of-full-stack-ai-infrastructure), [September 2025 financing](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-group-announces-closings-of-its-public-offering-of-class-a-ordinary-shares-and-concurrent-private-offering-of-convertible-senior-notes-with-aggregate-gross-proceeds-to-date-of-approximately-4-2-billion), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Portfolio Complexity and Management Bandwidth

There was also an integration risk layered on top of the capital and power story. Nebius entered 2026 not just with a huge build schedule, but with an active acquisition agenda around Tavily, Eigen AI and Clarifai. Those deals may have improved the software stack, yet they also added onboarding, retention and execution complexity at exactly the point when management was trying to turn a contract book into live capacity. [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

Toloka's deconsolidation reduced one layer of complexity, but it did not turn Nebius into a pure single-asset story. Avride and TripleTen remained consolidated, and Nebius was simultaneously integrating Tavily, Eigen AI and Clarifai capabilities into the software stack. That portfolio breadth offered optionality; it also risked stretching senior management at the same moment the company needed near-perfect execution on power, financing and customer delivery. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

## Macro and Demand Risk

| Risk area | What changed by the frozen snapshot date | What still had to be watched |
|---|---|---|
| Financing | Cash rose to $9.3B and Q1 fundraising totaled $6.3B | Capex guide still far exceeded cash on hand |
| Customer transparency | Microsoft and Meta were publicly named | Concentration still looked high because contract size was enormous |
| Power | Contracted power rose above 3.5GW | Connected and active power still had to catch up |
| Product stack | Tavily, Eigen AI and Clarifai added software depth | Integration burden increased alongside the buildout |

[Sources: Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

Finally, Nebius was still exposed to the durability of the AI capex cycle itself. The company had done a great deal to move from speculative pipeline to contracted demand, but even long-duration contracts sit inside a broader market defined by hyperscaler spending, model-training economics and inference demand. If that cycle cooled sharply, Nebius would still own the sites, the power commitments and the depreciation schedule. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

chapters.title: The FY2026 execution test
chapters.body:
## The Numbers on the Table Had Already Moved

By the frozen snapshot date, the outlook chapter could no longer rely only on the February 2026 guide. Nebius had already reported the first quarter that was supposed to validate that guide. Management was still targeting $3.0 billion to $3.4 billion of 2026 revenue, $7 billion to $9 billion of year-end ARR, around 40% adjusted EBITDA margin in the core business, and 800 MW to 1 GW of connected power. But investors now also had a real first-quarter operating print: $399.0 million of group revenue, $389.7 million of AI cloud revenue, $1.92 billion of ARR, $2.258 billion of operating cash flow and $9.3 billion of cash. [Nebius Q4 / FY2025 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Financing the Build

The single biggest change from the earlier draft was financial starting position. At year-end 2025, Nebius had $3.7 billion of cash. By March 31, 2026, it had $9.3 billion after $6.3 billion of fundraising in the quarter. That did not eliminate the gap between the balance sheet and the $16 billion to $20 billion capex plan, but it materially changed the near-term probability that financing, rather than execution, would be the first thing to break. [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## The Capacity Outlook

The capacity map also improved. Nebius said contracted power exceeded 3.5 GW in Q1 2026 and raised year-end 2026 contracted-power guidance to more than 4 GW. It had announced a 310 MW Finnish AI factory in March, a Pennsylvania site with up to 1.2 GW of secured power in May, and said it had already secured two gigawatt-scale sites in the United States. The connected-power target, however, stayed at 800 MW to 1 GW. That distinction was the heart of the 2026 outlook: contracted power and capital were racing ahead of connected power, and the market needed to watch the latter. [Finland AI factory](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-to-construct-310-mw-ai-factory-in-finland), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## Revenue Conversion

The quarterly math remained demanding even after the strong first quarter. A $399.0 million Q1 run rate annualized to well below the midpoint of the $3.0 billion to $3.4 billion full-year guide, which meant Nebius still needed the year to bend sharply upward as new capacity came online. The contract book explained why management believed that was achievable. The still-low level of active and connected power versus contracted power explained why the market could not take it for granted. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

The revenue task was still severe but no longer abstract. Q1 group revenue of $399.0 million meant Nebius had covered a meaningful portion of the annual guide early in the year, but it also meant the company still needed a very steep ramp through the remaining quarters to reach even the low end of the range. What changed in Nebius's favor was that the customer side of the bridge looked firmer than before: Microsoft and Meta were publicly named, the company said all Q1 strategic-contract capacity commitments had been met, and more than half of the year-end ARR target remained contracted. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta)

## Margin and Product Mix

Management's margin aspiration also looked somewhat less heroic after Q1. The company said Nebius AI cloud adjusted EBITDA margin reached 45% in the quarter, while product additions such as Token Factory, Tavily, Eigen AI and Clarifai suggested the group was trying to move further up the stack into inference and agentic software rather than remain a pure hardware-rental business. If that product broadening worked, the margin structure could improve more quickly than a bare-metal compute business normally would. [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Nebius Token Factory launch](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-launches-nebius-token-factory-to-deliver-production-ai-inference-at-scale), [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

## Corporate Optionality

The balance-sheet strength at Q1 also made the capital-allocation question more interesting. Nebius told shareholders it planned to deploy cash in a disciplined manner and would evaluate potential acquisitions that deepened technology and product capabilities. That statement mattered because it meant 2026 was not only a year of execution against an existing plan. It was also a year in which management believed it still had room to reshape the software stack while the physical buildout continued. [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

Nebius also retained optionality outside the core cloud. Toloka was now an equity-method investment rather than a consolidated subsidiary. TripleTen and Avride remained inside the group, with TripleTen still growing and Avride backed by a disclosed Uber partnership. That meant the company still had portfolio choices available later, even if the frozen-window record did not show a declared spin, sale or IPO process for any of those assets. [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z), [Avride-Uber partnership](https://nebius.com/newsroom/avride-announces-up-to-375-million-investment-and-strategic-partnership-with-uber)

## The Real Test

The real FY2026 test had therefore become narrower and more exact. Nebius no longer needed to prove that demand existed, that the market would finance it, or that the company could put up one spectacular quarter. It needed to prove that a very large disclosed contract base, a very large disclosed capex plan and a very large disclosed power pipeline could all be synchronized without a material slippage in delivery. That was still an unusually high bar. It was simply a better-funded and better-documented one than the earlier draft recognized. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

## A. Glossary

**Annualized run-rate revenue (ARR).** Nebius defined ARR by taking Nebius AI cloud revenue from the last month of the quarter and multiplying it by 12. The company reported $1.25 billion of ARR at year-end 2025 and $1.92 billion in Q1 2026. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

**Aether.** Nebius's cloud platform release family. The company highlighted Aether 3.1 in late 2025 and Aether 3.5 in Q1 2026 as releases that improved enterprise readiness, serverless AI, data transfer and governance tooling. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

**Connected power / active power / contracted power.** Nebius used three related terms. Contracted power referred to secured land and power, connected power to power connected into built data centers, and active power to power being consumed by IT equipment. The distinction mattered because Nebius ended 2025 with about 170 MW of active power, while by Q1 2026 contracted power exceeded 3.5 GW and year-end contracted-power guidance had been raised to more than 4 GW. [Nebius Q4 2025 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/e59fb92e-9027-473a-8cac-04f9d2e9ea9a/Shareholder%20Letter%20Q4%202025.pdf), [Nebius Q1 2026 shareholder letter](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/aa1bc2e6-df83-40cd-a6a2-95e7cda3d16c/Nebius%20SHL_Q1%202026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-05-13T14%3A00%3A35.352Z)

**Customer prepayment.** Large AI cloud contracts produced cash ahead of revenue recognition. The cleanest public example was $834 million of Q4 2025 operating cash flow against $227.7 million of revenue, followed by $2.258 billion of Q1 2026 operating cash flow against $399.0 million of revenue. [Nebius Q4 2025 financial release PDF](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/04f48f4e-48e9-468e-a428-ef16565c3fb5/Financial%20results_Q4%202025_11022026.pdf?cache-buster=2026-02-12T11%3A56%3A40.932Z), [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf)

**Portfolio perimeter.** By Q1 2026, Nebius consolidated the core AI cloud business, Avride and TripleTen, while Toloka was accounted for as an equity-method investment after the May 2025 transaction led by Bezos Expeditions. [Nebius Q1 2026 results](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/6fc0ea6c-0884-4a1f-bed8-1f797eb9628f/Financial%20results_Q1%202026.pdf), [Toloka transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-bezos-expeditions-as-lead-investor-in-ai-data-business-toloka)

**Strategic contracts.** By the frozen snapshot date, Nebius had publicly disclosed a Microsoft agreement with current value of about $17.4 billion through 2031, rising to about $19.4 billion with additional services, and a Meta agreement with total value of up to about $27 billion over five years. [Microsoft 6-K](https://assets.nebius.com/assets/86625727-9e66-46c1-af79-c27d57434e3c/25-25580-1_Nebius%2520Group%2520N.V._6-K.pdf?cache-buster=2025-09-08T21%3A23%3A09.625Z), [Meta agreement](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-signs-new-ai-infrastructure-agreement-with-meta)

**Token Factory.** Nebius's managed inference platform, launched in November 2025 and then expanded by the Tavily, Eigen AI and Clarifai transactions in 2026. [Token Factory launch](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-launches-nebius-token-factory-to-deliver-production-ai-inference-at-scale), [Tavily acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-announces-agreement-to-acquire-tavily-to-add-agentic-search-to-its-ai-cloud-platform), [Eigen AI acquisition](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-agrees-to-acquire-eigen-ai-strengthening-nebius-token-factory-as-a-frontier-inference-platform), [Clarifai transaction](https://nebius.com/newsroom/nebius-welcomes-clarifais-core-team-and-licenses-inference-ip-to-strengthen-nebius-token-factory)

financials.key_finding: Nebius's FY2025 print is the most aggressive AI-infrastructure ramp in the public-equity peer set: Q4 2025 revenue $227.7M (+547% YoY) with the core AI cloud segment alone +802% YoY, ARR $1.25B exit-2025, capex ~$2B in Q4 alone, cash $3.7B year-end, 170MW active power against 2GW+ contracted. The FY2026 guidance — revenue $3-3.4B (~7x FY25), adj EBITDA margin ~40%, capex $16-20B, ARR $7-9B with more than half already contracted, 800MW-1GW connected power — is the most aggressive guidance any AI-cloud company has issued.

structural_observations: Q4 revenue of $227.7M was below analyst expectations of $247M — the miss did not change the FY2026 guidance trajectory.
The $834M Q4 operating cash flow vs $227.7M Q4 revenue gap is the customer-prepayment signature: hyperscaler-style customers prepay AI compute, generating cash ahead of recognised revenue.
Capex of ~$2B in Q4 alone against revenue of $227.7M is a 9x capex-to-revenue ratio — this is build-ahead-of-demand infrastructure spending.
ARR of $1.25B exit-2025 with FY2026 ARR target $7-9B (>50% contracted) implies ARR will grow roughly 5-7x in 2026 on contracted-basis visibility, not speculative pipeline.

Connected power scaling from 170MW (end-2025) to 800MW-1GW (end-2026) is a 5-6x physical-capacity expansion in one year — requires concurrent execution across power utility agreements, real estate, hardware procurement (Nvidia GPU allocation), and customer ramp.
Net loss of $249.6M in Q4 alone reflects the depreciation and stock-comp impact of the scale-up; cash burn is offset by the $700M strategic financing and the $834M Q4 operating cash flow.
